challenge.prompt: Using three.js, create a cinematic flythrough of a procedurally generated cyberpunk city at night. Requirements: hundreds of skyscrapers with emissive window lights and neon signs in pink, cyan and purple; wet reflective streets; volumetric-looking fog; a few flying cars moving along paths between buildings; a bloom post-processing effect (EffectComposer + UnrealBloomPass); and a smooth automatic camera path that glides between the towers. Use the requestAnimationFrame timestamp for animation time. Full-window canvas that handles resizing. Starts automatically, no interaction needed.
